name: whatsapp_inbound_messages
description: Durable intake of supported and authenticated Meta messages for the configured business number.
lifecycle: Created before acknowledging the webhook. Redelivery preserves the original row. Processing and retention are release-plan work.

columns.Meaning: Opaque Meta message identifier used to deduplicate redelivery.
Meta asset identifier of the business number that received the event.
Meta sender identifier scoped to the business portfolio.
columns.Null meaning: Meta supplied only the sender phone number.

columns.Meaning: Sender number supplied by Meta to support directory linking and routing.
columns.Null meaning: Meta supplied a business-scoped sender identifier without a phone number.

columns.Meaning: Timestamp reported by Meta as the message time.
Database timestamp of the first accepted delivery.
Normalized text, action identifier, media reference or protected verification-code digest consumed by the conversation flow.

constraints.Purpose: Keeps one accepted event per Meta message ID across retries and concurrent delivery.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((sender_business_id IS NOT NULL) OR (sender_phone IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: Requires at least one sender identifier so a message can be associated with a conversation.
